title: not-uber-service - fleet
description: Where the fleet is. Every point is one driver at their last reported position, coloured by what they are doing. driver_positions carries latitude and longitude directly, so this is the raw telemetry with no modelling in between - which makes it the most direct proof that the whole pipeline works end to end.

panels.title: Drivers reporting
panels.description: Distinct drivers that sent a position in the selected range. Only online drivers report, so this is the size of the working fleet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(driver_id) AS drivers FROM nus.driver_positions WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: What the fleet is doing
panels.description: The same three states the map is coloured by, as numbers. Colour alone never carries identity here - the state is written out beside every bar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExactIf(driver_id, last_status = 'idle') AS `waiting for a trip`, uniqExactIf(driver_id, last_status = 'en_route_pickup') AS `heading to a pickup`, uniqExactIf(driver_id, last_status = 'on_trip') AS `carrying a rider` FROM (SELECT driver_id, argMax(status, event_time) AS last_status FROM nus.driver_positions WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY driver_id)

panels.title: Median speed
panels.description: Across drivers currently carrying a rider. Free-flow in this city is about 26 km/h, so a number well below that is congestion the routing costs should already be reflecting.

targets.rawSql: SELECT median(speed_kmh) AS kmh FROM nus.driver_positions WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND status = 'on_trip' AND speed_kmh > 1

panels.title: Positions behind by
panels.description: Age of the newest driver position. If this climbs, the fleet on the map is stale and nothing below it can be trusted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dateDiff('second', max(event_time), now()) AS seconds_behind FROM nus.driver_positions

panels.title: Where the drivers are
panels.description: One point per driver, at their last known position in the selected range. Blue is waiting for a trip, orange is heading to a pickup, green is carrying a rider - the three states validated as distinguishable together for colour-vision deficiency.

defaults.noValue: no driver positions in this range - is driver-service running?

targets.rawSql: SELECT driver_id, argMax(lat, event_time) AS latitude, argMax(lon, event_time) AS longitude, argMax(status, event_time) AS state, argMax(zone_id, event_time) AS zone FROM nus.driver_positions WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY driver_id

panels.title: Supply and demand by zone
panels.description: Free drivers against riders still waiting, per zone, newest score first. A zone with waiting riders and no free drivers is where the next no_driver_found will come from.

defaults.noValue: no demand scores in this range - is city-service running?

targets.rawSql: SELECT zone_id, argMax(demand_score, computed_at) AS demand, argMax(open_requests, computed_at) AS waiting, argMax(available_drivers, computed_at) AS free FROM nus.hotspot_history WHERE $__timeFilter(computed_at) GROUP BY zone_id ORDER BY demand DESC LIMIT 20
